messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-35891 triggered for inference-gateway-eu1 — alert="http_5xx_rate>2.5%" route=/v1/chat messages. runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx.
Riley Cooper: acked and oncall. checking deploys and autoscale events. anyone near eu1?
Priya Shah: I9m in eu1 pager. no recent service deploys in last 30m per CI logs. I see a brief autoscale activity at 08:41:12 UTC that removed 3 instances from model-pool-eu1 due to a healthcheck regression. forwarding autoscale log.
Tom Baker: looking at proxy metrics — 5xx split: ~60% 502, ~30% 504, ~10% 500. Upstreams show connection_reset and some 429s from model-hosts. suspect cascading backpressure after scale-down.
Riley Cooper: can we temporarily route traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-eu1) for high-qps customers? ops, please prepare a reroute.
infra-bot: Initiating routing change: redirect high-QPS customers (tag=priority=high) from inference-gateway-eu1 -> dedicated-eu1. Dry-run policy applied, awaiting approval.
Priya Shah: approved. go ahead.
infra-bot: Routing change applied. expected propagation 7s. :rocket:
Tom Baker: after reroute, 5xx rate dropped from 3.8% -> 1.6% over next 90s for priority traffic, but global rate still ~2.2%. KV cache miss rate spiked to 0.87 at 08:42:30. eviction_count also spiked.
Riley Cooper: runbook step: try prefix warmup and restart the most erroring model-hosts (IDs: mh-eu-45, mh-eu-46). Priya, can you run warmup? Tom, please queue rolling restart on mh-eu-45 first.
Priya Shah: running warmup: `./tools/prefetch --region=eu1 --top=300 --concurrency=8`
```
prefetch queued=300
inflight=8
progress=90/300
```
Priya Shah: warmup progressing. cache hit for top prefixes improving.
Tom Baker: restarting mh-eu-45 now. brief drain, restart, healthchecks. logs:
```
2026-03-15T08:43:12Z mh-eu-45 drain start
2026-03-15T08:43:25Z mh-eu-45 stop service
2026-03-15T08:43:40Z mh-eu-45 start service
2026-03-15T08:44:05Z mh-eu-45 healthcheck passed
```
Tom Baker: mh-eu-45 healthy. monitoring.
Riley Cooper: customer-impact check: CS-notify-bot, did any customers page SRE or open tickets?
CS-notify-bot: Customer X (voice-prod) reported errors 08:42-08:46 UTC, created support ticket TCK-998. Customer Y saw transient latency but no errors. Both notified of mitigation.
Tom Baker: warmup complete. cache hit rate on hot set up from 12% -> 81%. 5xx rate falling to 0.5% across eu1. residual 504s likely from a single older host that still has high conn counts, marking for follow-up.
Priya Shah: created follow-up RED-4399: investigate autoscale healthcheck regression that removed instances and caused cascading backpressure. attaching autoscale events and healthcheck traces.
Riley Cooper: adding immediate runbook change: add pre-promotion KV pre-warm and a guard to prevent autoscale scale-in >2 instances in 5m when kvcache_miss_rate >0.3. assigning to eng-runtime and autoscale teams.
infra-bot: Created ticket RED-4399 and assigned to eng-runtime, autoscale.
Riley Cooper: Confirming stabilization: last 10m window 5xx rate 0.3% and error-free for high-QPS customers. closing PD incident.
incident-bot: Incident INC-35891 closed by Riley Cooper. duration 00:09:10. :white_check_mark:
Tom Baker: leaving notes: need to audit healthcheck flakiness on mh-eu-46 and add canary gate to block aggressive scale-in when cache warmup not complete.
Priya Shah: scheduling 30m postmortem tomorrow 13:00 UTC, will include CS timeline and autoscale logs.
Riley Cooper: thanks team. follow-ups: RED-4399 (autoscale), RFC-1212 (canary gating), RED-4400 (kv-cache tuning). signing off.
